content.text: I've escalated ticket T-4005 to a human engineer. The pods show as Running and Ready, but the ingress-nginx is returning 502 Bad Gateway errors. Based on my investigation of the Kubernetes documentation and the cluster state, the most likely cause is a port configuration mismatch between the Kubernetes service and where the storefront-web 3.0 application is actually listening. This requires human investigation to check whether version 3.0 changed the listening port and verify the service configuration matches.
